model.title: A resolution supporting the goals and ideals of a National Move Over Law Day.

summary.text: The resolution seeks to establish and promote a National Move Over Law Day to raise awareness about laws requiring drivers to slow down and change lanes when approaching stopped emergency vehicles and other roadside workers.
